system.description: You have achieved a certain mastery of the Beast within yourself and may enter and exit any frenzy at will, choosing and controlling the type of frenzy you enter and your actions throughout. To enter frenzy this way, you must lose one Social Trait and one Willpower Trait. The frenzy ends whenever you choose, or after 10 minutes have elapsed. A character in frenzy gains the following: Rage Frenzy grants Ferocious x2 and Tenacious; Control Frenzy grants Ferocious x2 and Tough; Terror Frenzy grants Ferocious x2 and Brutal, plus immunity to Presence, Dominate, and any other non-Animalism Social Challenge.
